<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Tenure milestone:</strong> The Union Cabinet passed a resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi for becoming the longest-serving elected Prime Minister of India.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Election preparedness:</strong> The Election Commission of India concluded its National Round Table Conference, while the Congress party appointed social media coordinators for Uttarakhand ahead of the 2027 polls.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNMDdrUnZqWDZVODhIYllhWkx6QmQxbHFQN1g1Z1ZhMlNhWkEtQ2FRUU9yWU5QZ25iYlJSaWd1MWtELXdSVk8zcTlXdjc2M1RfckJqSEotMHFDSElQTjM4eVVfZ0Fod09WU3ptRE92LV9MQ2IyU1VMa19mTm1iN1hsZ0xPelhRcHhJdXpER3RKRUNkQ2NSTVhMV2hFTUtQWmFabUJWTGhEemludnVvV2ppQUc1UFZvRm8?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a></span></li>
